newsitem.title: VATICAN: Papal audience cancelled, Pope told to rest.
newsitem.headline: Papal audience cancelled, Pope told to rest.

text.p: Pope John Paul cancelled his weekly general audience on Wednesday after his doctor ordered him to rest.

An announcement over loudspeakers made in St Peter's Square said the Pope, 76, would briefly greet pilgrims from the window of his private apartment but would not hold the audience. No details of his condition were immediately available.

The Polish-born Pontiff has suffered a string of health problems in recent years, including surgery to remove a colon tumour in 1992, a hip replacement operation in 1994 and an operation last October to remove his appendix.
His doctors ordered him to slow down after the most recent surgery and he did not say Christmas Day mass last year.
He has at least five foreign trips planned for 1997, including a one-day visit to the Bosnian capital Sarajevo in April.
Wednesday's brief announcement was broadcast in several languages in the square. It said the Pope's doctor had advised him to rest.
